why: Rebuilds the column headers out of DATA cells, exactly as they shipped: 'Lifetime' and 'Level attempt' head nothing and every figure beneath them is announced bare. The table still renders identically -- <td> and <th> differ in default weight and alignment, which this table's own CSS already overrides -- so no visual guard can see it. Killed by 2: the scoped-header assertion here, and the stats-page wording test in hud.controls.test.ts, which reads those two names THROUGH `thead th[scope=col]` for precisely this reason. The wording it pins is only worth something while it is still attached to a column.
